summary: Iter5 — Reviewed and validated all four asks: (1) /api/leaves/overlap, (2) extended /api/leave-balances, (3) sidebar rename to 'Leave Tour Approvals', (4) per-row chevron expander on Approvals with OverlapNotice + BalanceSummaryCard side-by-side, (5) LeaveBalances revamp with 3 column groups + totals strip. Backend: 10/10 new iter5 tests pass; 210/210 total pytest still green (no regressions). Frontend (public preview URL): admin login via phone bypass 9849002111 works. Sidebar item renders as 'Leave Tour Approvals' with data-testid='nav-leave-tour-approvals'. Apply modal on /my-leaves shows overlap notice once start+end dates are picked (overlap-empty for far-future window, overlap-notice with chips for current window) and HIDES the notice for Late-Coming type (confirmed: all three overlap testids absent). Admin Approvals: 125 leave rows render, 122 have expand chevrons, 3 late_coming-type rows correctly have no expander. Clicking expand reveals detail-row with both OverlapNotice + balance-card; lazy-load verified — exactly 1 hit to /api/members/{uid}/leave-summary on first expand, 0 additional hits on subsequent collapse/re-expand. Admin LeaveBalances: lb-total-paid, lb-total-comp, lb-total-tour cards render with live sums (Opening 592.5 · Used 47 · Balance 545.5; Accrued 1 · Used 5 · Available 1; Total 28); per-row testids lb-paid-used/balance, lb-co-accrued/used/avail, lb-tour all present and numeric; totals strip respects search filter (filtered to zero rows → all totals show 0). Waterfall regression intact: POST /api/leaves type='leave' still stamps comp_off_used/paid_leave_used/lop_days summing to window length; type='tour' does NOT stamp.

issues: Pre-existing: native HTML <input type=date> used instead of the shadcn Calendar component — same as prior iterations, NOT introduced by this iteration. Non-blocking and out of scope for current asks.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/leaves.py /leaves/overlap: correct use of inverse-overlap formula (start_date <= end AND end_date >= start), excludes 'rejected' and 'late_coming' as specified, accepts optional exclude_user_id + leave_id. Available to any authenticated user (only get_current_user dependency, no admin gate) — matches PRD. Returns a denormalised safe summary excluding reason/internal fields — good.

server.py /leave-balances extension: comp-off accrual is computed from this year's attendance ∩ user's weekly_off; uses a single bulk fetch of attendance + leaves (not per-user) — efficient for ~133 members. Invariant comp_off_available = max(0, accrued - used) holds.
Lazy-loading on Approvals balance card verified at the network level: subsequent expand/collapse does NOT re-fetch /leave-summary — implementation correctly memoises per leave_id.

OverlapNotice.jsx: three render states (loading/empty/notice) are mutually exclusive with distinct testids — testable. Header is the toggle (data-testid='overlap-toggle'), details only mount on expand — good for tab-order and accessibility.

LeaveBalances.jsx totals strip subscribes to the same filtered rowset that feeds the table — both update together when search changes. The 'no opening balance set' fallback string still shows when opening=0 in the per-row Paid Available card; verify with PM if this should also dash-out instead of showing literal 0.

Minor observation (non-blocking): on Approvals, the late_application=true badge ('late-chip') is rendered for late-submission leaves of any type, while expander absence is gated only on type='late_coming'. This is the intended distinction (a late-applied leave still has multi-day overlap value) but worth documenting so future maintainers don't conflate the two.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 4 asks verified: sidebar rename, OverlapNotice in apply form, Approvals expander with balance+overlap cards, LeaveBalances 3-column-group table + totals strip

test_credentials: Phone OTP bypass 9849002111 (admin) — confirmed working. admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 also valid.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST leaves created (1 leave + 1 tour) on a coach member during the waterfall-stamping regression test — both immediately rejected via PATCH to remove from active sets. Production data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 contract verified end-to-end. Key testids to remember: nav-leave-tour-approvals (sidebar), overlap-notice / overlap-empty / overlap-loading / overlap-toggle / overlap-details / overlap-group-{kind} / overlap-chip-{id} (OverlapNotice), expand-{leaveId} / detail-row-{leaveId} / balance-card / balance-loading / balance-comp-off / balance-paid-leave / balance-ladder / balance-tour-note (Approvals row expander), lb-total-paid / lb-total-comp / lb-total-tour, lb-row-{id}, lb-paid-used-{id}, lb-paid-balance-{id}, lb-co-accrued-{id}, lb-co-used-{id}, lb-co-avail-{id}, lb-tour-{id} (LeaveBalances). Backend contract: GET /api/leaves/overlap?start_date=&end_date=&exclude_user_id=&leave_id= returns list of {id, user_id, full_name, category, rank, institution, fleet, type, status, start_date, end_date, location}. Late-coming rows correctly excluded from this endpoint. Run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_review_iter5.py tests/test_unified_leave_iter4.py tests/test_routes_leaves.py -v`.
rca of the issue: N/A — all four iter5 asks behave as specified, no defects found.
